rationale: The heritage ANCHOR question, made observable: with the clause on its own lines the DECLARATION line (7) and the PARENT's own line (8/9) are different numbers, so a handler that anchors on the declaration start (the pre-fix behaviour) cannot pass. Pinned by scala/extends-clause-start-line, which sets every heritage row's line to the source declaration line.

expectRelationships.note: the parent's own line, not the declaration's
